title: Kehti Thi Bano Asghar
body:
kehti thi bano asghar jaani
kab tum ghar may aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
darya par se pee kar pani
kab tum ghar may aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
ay mere jaani yusuf e saani
kab tum ghar may aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
apni dikhane shakl numaani
kab tum ghar may aaoge
<<DIVIDER>>
sog may tere beta maine
pehni kafni kaali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoore baalon waale aaja
jhoola tera khaali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi bano asghar jaani
